note: Every game built on game-kit, plus the engines it was extracted from.

games.name: neon-games
games.description: Two free open-world browser games on the Neon Engine — Dead Zone (zombie survival) and Neon Police. Playable in the browser, no install. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

games.name: neon-runner
games.description: Retro auto-fire side-scrolling shooter. Move, jump, duck — your gun fires itself. One self-contained HTML file, zero dependencies, fully offline.

games.name: retro-strike
games.description: 🎮 A complete retro 3rd-person shooter in a single HTML file — custom software 3D renderer, chiptune audio, zero dependencies.

games.name: idle-city-ages-of-growth
games.description: A single-file idle city-builder that grows from a Stone Age village into a Fusion Age world-city. Zero dependencies, fully offline, mobile-ready. By Dr. Sohil Momin. Source-available: free for non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use requires a licence.

games.name: dance-fight
games.description: A browser dance-fighting game where every fight move is a dance move. Load your own track and the character dances to its actual beat grid. Single HTML file, no dependencies, no build step.

games.name: aethelgard-games
games.description: Two free browser games by Dr. Sohil Momin — Aethelgard: The Books (visual novel) and Aethelgard: Chronicles of Fate (RPG). Playable on GitHub Pages.

games.name: AethelgardVN
games.description: Visual Novel based on Aethelgard: Chronicles of Fate RPG with Base Engine

engines.name: neon-engine
engines.description: A code-only open-world game engine for the browser. No assets, no build step, no dependencies — every texture, mesh and sound is generated at runtime. PolyForm Noncommercial licensed.

engines.name: Aethelgard-Engine
engines.description: Aethelgard-Engine base Engine for Aethlgard RPG Game
